name: guard-provider
description: Guard Provider — full-stack platform connecting customers with verified security professionals

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"

scripts.build: npm run build -w @guard-provider/shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
